campaign: A (CUSUM K5 lower front: m1 11-35, m2 11-41, m3 11-42, m5 11-44; 122 open (m, cell) pairs)
frozen_before: any route forecast of this campaign and any certified or real computation of this campaign

universe.source: phase_a/LOWER_FRONT_BLOCKER_MAP.json (replay of the adopted map r3)

scenarios.NOMINAL: adopted certified values as recorded; measured adopted-record inputs as recorded; every input that is NOT yet measured or certified (a quantity the route would newly compute) at its best available estimate, stated in the forecast
scenarios.CONSERVATIVE: as NOMINAL, but every not-yet-measured input multiplied by 4 in the unfavourable direction; adopted certified constants and adopted-record measured values unchanged

closure_rule: a pair (m, cell) is forecast CLOSED iff the frozen K5-B (k5b_check.k5b_literal, ddd54dc4) run on the adopted inputs plus the route's forecast enclosures passes that cell; no other criterion

classes.USEFUL: not STRONG, and (CONSERVATIVE closes >= 61/122 pairs or NOMINAL closes 122/122 pairs)
classes.MARGINAL: not USEFUL, and NOMINAL closes >= 1 pair
classes.INFEASIBLE: NOMINAL closes 0 pairs, or the route is mathematically ruled out before forecasting

compute_gate.rule: a route whose forecast new-real CPU-hours exceed the hard budget is not launched; a route over the preferred budget needs its excess justified in the route comparison

selection_rule: select the route with the highest class; among equal classes prefer zero new real addresses, then the smaller forecast new-real CPU-hours; a route below USEFUL is never executed
stop_rule: if every route is MARGINAL or INFEASIBLE, stop Campaign A scientific execution and write a costed continuation plan
no_redefinition: these classes, scenarios and rules are not changed after any forecast or result is seen
